newsitem.title: USA: R.R. Donnelley names acting chairman.
newsitem.headline: R.R. Donnelley names acting chairman.

text.p: R.R. Donnelley & Sons Co said Wednesday its board elected John Richman as acting chairman and chief executive officer, replacing John Walter, who resigned to become president and chief operating officer of AT&T Corp, effective November 1.
The board will begin selecting Walter's permanent successor immediately.
Walter, 49, joined R.R. Donnelley in 1969 as a sales trainee. He became chairman and CEO in 1989.
Richman said Donnelley formed an office of the chairman, composed of the four current members of the company's management committee and James Donnelley, vice chairman.

Members of the committee, all executive vice presidents, are Steven Baumgartner, sector president - Global Commercial Print; Cheryl Francis, chief financial officer; W. Ed Tyler, sector president - Information Management; and Jonathan Ward, sector president - Commercial Print.

Richman, 68, has been a director of R.R. Donnelley since 1988 and is a member of the board's audit, human resources and nominating and governance committees. He currently serves as counsel to the law firm of Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen and Katz.
In his career, Richman has served as vice chairman of Philip Morris Cos and chairman and chief executive officer of Kraft Inc.
R.R. Donnelley, a printing company, specializes in the production of catalogs, inserts, magazines, books, directories and financial and computer documentation.
